mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in unemployment signals a weakening labor market and consumer spending that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals a strengthening economy that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and consumer spending that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real retail sales signals a strengthening consumer sector that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market and consumer spending that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in CPI inflation signals a weakening purchasing power that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal
